name: The Journey Has Just Begun
summary: In Stormwind, Major Mattingly honors the artisan who brought down Onyxia. He teaches the craft of making a cloak from her scales.

sections.title: A Rare Mastery
sections.body: Few who helped bring down Onyxia can work her hide. When a master leatherworker comes to Major Mattingly in Stormwind, the officer sees how much that skill may matter in battles ahead.

sections.title: Protection Against the Black Dragonflight
sections.body: Onyxia's death leaves the black dragonflight a threat. Major Mattingly teaches the artisan to treat and stitch her scales into an Onyxia Scale Cloak. It wards against the fiery breath of her brother, Nefarian, the Lord of Blackrock.

faq.q: Who offers the quest The Journey Has Just Begun?
aliases: who gives the journey has just begun
where to get journey has just begun
journey has just begun quest giver
faq.answer: Major Mattingly in Stormwind City offers this knowledge to Alliance heroes who fought in the campaign against Onyxia and have mastered leatherworking.

aliases: reward for journey has just begun
faq.answer: Major Mattingly teaches master leatherworkers to make an Onyxia Scale Cloak from Onyxia's scales.

faq.q: Why is the Onyxia Scale Cloak necessary?
aliases: why do i need onyxia cloak
what is onyxia scale cloak for
faq.answer: The Onyxia Scale Cloak shields its wearer from the fiery breath of Nefarian, the Lord of Blackrock.

faq.q: Who is the Lord of Blackrock mentioned by Major Mattingly?
faq.answer: Nefarian is the Lord of Blackrock, a powerful black dragon and Onyxia's brother. He rules Blackrock Spire and continues the black dragonflight's schemes.

faq.q: Why must the hero be a leatherworker to receive this knowledge?
faq.answer: A master leatherworker has the advanced skill needed to work dragon scales without destroying their magical warding.

faq.q: Does Onyxia's death resolve the black dragon threat in Stormwind?
faq.answer: No. Onyxia is dead, but her brother Nefarian still commands Blackrock Mountain and plots against the Alliance and the mortal races.

angles.text: As an Alliance hero, you carry Stormwind's victory over Onyxia into the coming offensive against her brother Nefarian at Blackrock Mountain.
